lead: The final step of every rehabilitation plan.

sections.title: A. Return to sport as a continuum

blocks.text: Return to sport is a process with three stages [Ref – to verify 2016 consensus]:

items: **Return to participation**: training in a modified or restricted way.
**Return to sport**: playing the sport, but not yet at the desired performance.
**Return to performance**: playing at or above the pre-injury level.

rows: Time since injury or surgery, imaging if relevant, symptoms
Strength (LSI), range, hop and agility tests, sport-specific fitness, movement quality
Sport demands, level, timing in season, previous injuries
Shared decision between athlete, medical staff, coach
Single, triple, crossover and timed hop tests

blocks.text: Many clinicians aim for at least 90% LSI, but specific cut-offs differ between protocols [Ref – to verify].

items: Understand the job: physical demands (lifting, carrying, posture, repetition), hours, flexibility.
Use graded return: modified duties, reduced hours, gradual increase.
Communicate with the employer (with consent): fit notes or work capacity statements.
Address psychosocial barriers (blue and black flags, Vol 1 Ch 2).
Work conditioning or work hardening: simulate job tasks with progressive loading.

blocks.label: TEACHER'S VOICE
body: Being at work, with adjustments, is usually better for recovery than prolonged sickness absence [Ref – to verify]. Plan return to work as part of treatment, not after it.

rows: Running, strength (Nordic hamstring, squats), plyometrics, balance; about 20 min, at least 2 times weekly [Ref – to verify]
Kneeling, partner holds ankles, lower the body forward slowly
Side plank with upper leg on bench
ACL injury prevention, especially in female athletes
Rotator cuff and scapular strengthening, load monitoring

blocks.text: Adherence is the main factor in whether prevention programs work [Ref – to verify].

items: **What are the three stages of return to sport?** Participation, sport, performance.
**Why is psychological readiness assessed?** Fear and low confidence affect performance and reinjury risk.
**What makes prevention programs effective?** Regular performance with good adherence.
**What is graded return to work?** Gradually increasing hours and duties.
**Which exercise reduces hamstring strains?** Nordic hamstring exercise.

sections.title: Now You Should Be Able To

items: Use a structured return-to-sport framework and test battery.
Plan a graded return to work.

sections.A: Khel par wapsi ek silsila hai: participation (training mein hissa), sport (khel par wapsi) aur performance (pehle jaisi karkardagi).
sections.B: Lower limb ki test battery: taaqat ki symmetry, hop tests, movement quality aur patient ka nafsiyati hosla.
sections.C: Kaam par wapsi ke liye kaam ki jismani maang samjhein (uthana, posture, dohrana) aur dheere dheere wapsi ka plan.
sections.D: Chot se bachao ke programs jaise FIFA 11+ aur Nordic hamstring exercise.
sections.E: Sawaal hal karein, phir jawab dekhein.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
